method.account_marks: Held minute closes, entry reference after costs, exit balance after costs; flat marks retained.
method.drawdown_duration: Last equal high-water mark before trough to first recovery; otherwise censored at last mark. USD and percentage episodes reported separately.
method.duration_units: Fractional elapsed calendar days plus integer difference of New York calendar dates.
method.leverage_mean: Mean exposure/equity at right endpoints of each held minute; executions have zero time weight.
method.leverage_max: Held minute closes plus entry reference after cost, entry fill after commission, exit reference and fill before closing costs.
method.costs: Adverse fills and commissions independently recomputed; one day/360 short borrow per trade, charged at exit.
method.limitation: Minute resolution and simulated execution prices only; no intrabar extrema, ticks, margin liquidation, or true intraminute leverage.
